why: AWH 2026-10-11: most rate-less entries were rate-less because the sweep that added them never dug for the rate; deeper looks, especially at booking sites, kept finding rates that had been there all along. The 126 public 'no rate posted' entries had been written off as phone-call-only after their operator pages' $ lines were read; nobody had followed the Reserve/Book links.
method: One static fetch (browser UA) of each entry's website, every <a href>/<iframe src>/<script src> classified against known booking-engine hosts plus off-site links whose text says reserve/book; social links and site-asset scripts discarded, leads confirmed by hand. A lead is a page to quote, not a price: quote a date in the engine (recipes in audit/private_gap_browser/README.md).

note: 24 of the 108 public no-rate entries with a website link to a booking engine; 27 refused a non-browser fetch and need the browser; 18 have no website. The rest showed no booking link to a static fetch (JavaScript-built menus can still hide one).
result: Worked 2026-10-11: 17 of the 24 priced (unpriced 160 -> 143); 7 not, each with its reason under outcome.
result_fetch_refused: Worked 2026-10-11 in the browser: 16 of the 27 priced (unpriced 143 -> 127); 6 dead website links replaced (the agencies had moved: Bainbridge .org->.gov, Chenango County, Tulare County parks, Shelby County KY, Riverton, Silverton) and 7 booking/rate pages added; 11 not priced, each with its reason under outcome.
result_no_website: Worked 2026-10-11: 10 of the 18 priced (unpriced 127 -> 117) - 7 from the operator (village/city/county pages, Bloomfield's council minutes, Marathon County's fee schedule) and 3 from a dated camper report where no operator page exists (2024 or later only: Kymulga, Sandhill, Kinser). 14 got a website. 8 not priced; 3 of those look closed or mostly seasonal (Point A, Morgan's Landing, Hancock) and go to AWH.
